title: Why Power, Not Space, Is Becoming the Constraint
description: A field note on the shift from location-first to power-first data-centre development.
body: Data-centre conversations once began with land, connectivity and proximity to customers. Increasingly, they begin with a more basic question: where is the power?
AI infrastructure is intensifying a constraint the industry already understood. A suitable building is not useful without timely, reliable and scalable electricity.
This changes more than site selection. It changes partnerships, development timelines, commercial risk and the geography of future capacity.
DC Decoded follows these shifts without pretending that a complex infrastructure system can be reduced to a headline.
